verify it seats fully recessed and stays retained when inverted without adhesive."},"clearance_mm":0,"part":"hand_knob","params":["pocket_af","pocket_depth","nut_af","nut_h"]},{"hardware":"m3_nut","feature":"pocket_floor","params":["pocket_depth","hole_d"],"part":"hand_knob","id":"nut_seat_stop","relation":"seats","check":{"description":"Ensure the M3 nut seats firmly against the floor shoulder and cannot be pushed through the far side of the knob.","method":"none"}},{"clearance_mm":0.2,"part":"hand_knob","check":{"description":"Pass an M3 bolt through the through-hole to confirm it spins freely through the clearance hole and exits the far side.","method":"none"},"feature":"through_hole","params":["hole_d","bolt_d"],"relation":"clears","id":"bolt_clearance"}],"parts":[{"code":"import cadquery as cq
import math

def build(p):
    # Base outer cylinder
    r_outer = p.knob_diameter / 2.0
    body = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(r_outer).extrude(p.knob_height)

    # Ergonomic chamfers on top and bottom outer rims
    body = body.edges(">Z").chamfer(p.chamfer_top)
    body = body.edges("<Z").chamfer(p.chamfer_bottom)

    # Scallops for comfortable finger grip
    num_scallops = int(p.scallop_count)
    for i in range(num_scallops):
        angle = i * (2.0 * math.pi / num_scallops)
        cx = p.scallop_offset * math.cos(angle)
        cy = p.scallop_offset * math.sin(angle)
        scallop = (
            cq.Workplane("XY")
            .workplane(offset=-1.0)
            .transformed(offset=(cx, cy, 0))
            .circle(p.scallop_radius)
            .extrude(p.knob_height + 2.0)
        )
        body = body.cut(scallop)

    # Full through-hole for M3 bolt pass-through
    through_hole = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=-1.0)
        .circle(p.hole_d / 2.0)
        .extrude(p.knob_height + 2.0)
    )
    body = body.cut(through_hole)

    # Hex nut pocket from top face (+Z) down to internal shoulder
    z_floor = p.knob_height - p.pocket_depth
    r_in = p.pocket_af / 2.0
    r_out = r_in / math.cos(math.pi / 6.0)
    hex_pts = [
        (r_out * math.cos(math.radians(a)), r_out * math.sin(math.radians(a)))
        for a in [30, 90, 150, 210, 270, 330]
    ]
    hex_pocket = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=z_floor)
        .polyline(hex_pts)
        .close()
        .extrude(p.pocket_depth + 1.0)
    )
    body = body.cut(hex_pocket)

    return body
